feed.title: HeatWatch
feed.subtitle: Where heat is breaking records, who it is reaching, what the rules are about to require, and what can be done about it.

entry.title: Malawi's heatwave warning lapsed as South Africa's Limpopo heat was forecast to ease the same day
entry.summary: Malawi's weather service ran a severe heatwave warning across its southern and central districts from 20 to 23 October, a window that has now closed. — Sources: Malawi Department of Climate Change and Meteorological Services, warnings of 18 and 20 October 2026 · South African Weather Service via Briefly.co.za, 21 October 2026

entry.title: Spain's 2026 heat season was its deadliest on record, with 5,807 attributable deaths
entry.summary: Spain's health institute recorded 5,807 heat-attributable deaths between 15 May and 30 September, the highest total since its surveillance series began in 2015. — Sources: Instituto de Salud Carlos III, MoMo surveillance, final 2026 season total, reported 14 October 2026

entry.title: Indonesia's haze-season respiratory illness count passed 283,000
entry.summary: Indonesia has recorded 283,270 acute respiratory infections from its haze crisis between 18 August and 13 October, with 22.5 percent in children aged five and under. — Sources: Indonesian Ministry of Health data via Vietnam Plus and The Rakyat Post, 14-15 October 2026

entry.title: The Philippines set heat-index thresholds for suspending outdoor work
entry.summary: The labour department's new policy lets workers skip work when the heat index reaches 52°C, rated extreme danger, and bars forcing workers into direct sun exposure above 40°C, between noon and 3pm. — Sources: Daily Tribune (Philippines), 21 October 2026
